events.title: Merhaba! 大家好！こんにちは！안녕하세요! Four More Language Options Are Here!
events.summary: The latest update brings four more language options to Simple Football League Manager:- Turkish – Türkçe- Traditional Chinese – 繁體中文- Japanese – 日本語- Korean – 한국어Build your squad, plan your tactics and follow your club’s story in your preferred language. Just select it in the in-game settings and get ready for your next match!Thank you for playing, sharing your feedback and supporting this solo project. It’s great to welcome more football fans to the game!Teşekkürler! 謝謝！ありがとうございます！감사합니다!Tim

events.title: Six New Language Options Are Here!
events.summary: ¡Hola! Olá! Ciao! Bonjour!The latest update brings six new language options to Simple Football League Manager:Spanish (Spain)Spanish (Latin America)Portuguese (Portugal)Portuguese (Brazil)ItalianFrenchYou can now build your squad, plan your tactics and follow your club’s story in your preferred language. Just select it in the in-game settings!Spot an awkward phrase, a typo or text that’s still in English? Please share a screenshot and a short note. Your feedback helps me improve the translations

events.title: Now in Simplified Chinese – 现已支持简体中文！
events.summary: 大家好！ Simple Football League Manager now supports Simplified Chinese! You can switch to the new language in the in-game settings and enjoy building your club in Chinese.谢谢大家的支持！ Thanks for your support, and enjoy the game!Tim

events.title: Polish Language Update – Teraz Po Polsku!
events.summary: Cześć Polsko! Od dzisiaj gra dostępna jest również w języku polskim. Wystarczy wybrać język polski w Ustawieniach (Settings). Z tej okazji chciałem wprowadzić bardziej żółte kolory, ale zdałem sobie sprawę, że tak nie wypada.* Hello Poland! The game is now available in Polish. Just choose "Polski" in the in-game settings.*2137!

events.title: German Language Update – Jetzt auf Deutsch!
events.summary: Hallo zusammen! You can now play Simple Football League Manager in German! Just select Deutsch in the in-game settings.A big thank you to everyone who has been playing, testing and sharing their thoughts. As a solo developer, that support means a lot to me.Viel Spaß beim Spielen und danke für eure Unterstützung!Tim

events.title: Demo Update 0.46.79 (Community requests)
events.summary: Update 0.46.79 (Community requests)Improved Rob’s reportsExpanded Excel database editing: customise player age, nationality, attributes and up to two positions, plus each club’s starting balance.Choose your career’s starting year: 1900–2100 in the New Career menu

events.title: Demo Update 0.46.72
events.summary: In this update I fixed: - a tutorial bug, where one player could get two yellow cards, - a possible soft lock after Injury in tutorial. I also improved game performance on Windows and Steam and polished various in-game texts.
